summary: Yum China Holdings filed an 8-K reporting entry into a bridge credit agreement with HSBC and Citibank, providing a CNH 8.4 billion senior unsecured term loan to finance its acquisition of a membership interest from Yum! Brands under a June 16, 2026 purchase agreement. The loan bears interest at CNH HIBOR plus margin (~2% per annum), matures 180 days after funding, extendable up to 364 days, and allows voluntary prepayment. The filing is routine financing disclosure preceding the acquisition. Watch for closing conditions and regulatory approvals; risk-arb focus on acquisition completion and bridge takeout.
